newsitem.title: USA: Brady bonds higher, exaggerated by thin volume.
newsitem.headline: Brady bonds higher, exaggerated by thin volume.

text.p: Emerging debt prices were mostly higher on Thursday thanks to an absence of any shocks that might dim recent cheer, traders said.
"The trend is in place so there has to be an event to prevent the trend from continuing," a trader said.
Overall, Brady debt was up 1/8 to 1/2 a point, mostly because of thin volume, traders confirmed. Most issues narrowed to Treasuries, they said.
"We're only 10 percent of normal volume traded today," one trader said. "I don't think the spreads are relevant at all."
Among specific issues, Argentine debt rose strongly, with Argentine discounts AR425C23=RR up 3/8 of a point at 76-7/8 bid by mid-afternoon, traders said.
But that gain could largely be ignored because "there's been only maybe $5 million traded," one trader said.
Brazil "C" bonds BRD8D14=RR also got some attention, up 1/4 of a point at 74 bid, according to traders.
"That's mainly thin volume," said one trader, echoing the comments of several others.
Bulgarian debt, a hot issue of late because of political unrest, did not trade on Thursday because of a holiday in London. "There were bids but no offers," one trader said.
Bulgaria's ruling Socialists named Georgi Parvanov their party's leader on Monday, but they have yet to name a new prime minister, Reuters reported.
Bulgarian debt closed off 3/4 of a point on Tuesday after losing 1-1/2 points on Monday.
Traders quoted Peru Citi PEFLG91=RR bonds unchanged at 116 bid, where they have been parked for the past few days.
Of the approximately 400 hostages taken by Peruvian rebels last week, 104 remain captive inside the Japanese ambassador's home.

Rebels stormed the ambassador's residence in Lima on Tuesday, December 17. They threatened to kill about 400 hostages, including high-ranking foreign diplomats, unless the government freed jailed comrades of the Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA).
In the broader market, Argentine pars AR4C23=RR were up 1/8 at 63-5/8 bid, Venezuelan Pars VZ675C20=RR were up 1/4 at 76-1/4 bid and Mexico Pars MX625L19=RR were up 1/8 at 73-3/8 bid.
Russia's dollar Vnesh RUVNUSLNS=RR was quoted up 1/8 at 78-7/8 bid.
In U.S. Treasuries, the 30-year bond was up 4/32 at 99, yielding 6.58 percent.
